annotations.text:
The funnel in one line: calculate → estimate appears blurred → name/WhatsApp/email unlocks it → that submit IS the lead.

The gate mirrors the real tool (mq-gate / qqhGate) so the landing page and the in-CRM calculators behave the same way.

The Medical Card / Hibah switch is live — click either card.
Meta ads land on mobile, so this is the view that actually converts. Both products stay visible; the gate sits directly under the estimate.

Anything in [BRACKETS] with a gold dashed outline is a real fact I could not verify — annual limit, agent phone/email/coverage area. Fill those before this goes live.

RM168 is a sample estimate so the locked-result state reads correctly.

Lead Generation sits under Sales Pipeline in the sidebar, with Landing Page as its submenu.

Each landing page belongs to one agent — leads land in that agent's pipeline as New Lead, source Landing Page. No round-robin.
Same lead card, one extra row: the assigned-agent tag renders only for SuperAdmin / Group Manager / Unit Manager — the agent's own board stays uncluttered.
